issues.description: [bug-hunt] Onboarding: the "Weekly pace" the plan-ready screens promise can be ~2x what the diet the app actually built delivers. Two different formulas feed the same "Weekly pace kg/week" label. PostPlanTour (the screen every user sees on the happy path) shows calc.weeklyChange from calcOnboardingStats (src/lib/onboarding-calc.ts:104-118), which is DATE-DRIVEN: goal_delta / weeks_to_target (weights win over calorie math). PlanReadyOverview (the failure/retry-only surface, src/pages/onboarding/custom/PlanReadyOverview.tsx:110-124,338-347) OVERRIDES that with a CALORIE-DERIVED rate off the server target: (serverTarget - tdee) * 7 / 7700. When the requested timeline needs a faster loss than the safe deficit cap allows, these diverge and BOTH the tour + overview under/over-report vs reality. Worked example (female 80kg->65kg / 165cm / 30y, 120-day plan, activity_level blank -> 1.55 mult): BMR 1520, TDEE 2356, deficit capped at min(500, tdee-bmr)=500 -> target 1856 kcal. Date-driven pace = 15kg / 17.1wk = 0.88 kg/wk (shown on PostPlanTour). Calorie-derived pace = 500*7/7700 = 0.45 kg/wk (shown on PlanReadyOverview + what the 1856-kcal plan actually delivers). So the tour promises 0.88 kg/wk (goal hit in the chosen 17 wk) while the built plan only supports 0.45 kg/wk (goal really ~33 wk out). The pace gate on Screen4 only fires 'caution' here (1.09%/wk bodyweight = acknowledge-and-continue), so it does NOT block this case. Repro: onboard with an aggressive-but-acknowledgeable timeline, finish, read Weekly pace on the tour; force a save/finalize failure to also see PlanReadyOverview and compare. Two questions for owner (product call -> filing, not auto-fixing): (1) which number is the honest "Weekly pace" - the achievable calorie-derived rate, or the required-to-hit-date rate? (2) whichever we pick, PostPlanTour + PlanReadyOverview should show the SAME one. Note: happy path only shows PostPlanTour, so impact is the over-promise, not a side-by-side mismatch.

issues.description:
[suggestion] A fasting / eating-window timer — a live start/stop fast timer with preset windows (16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD) surfaced as a Dashboard card, reusing the app notification scheduler for window reminders.

PROBLEM: NYUS is an India-focused weight-loss app but has NO way to track intermittent fasting or an eating window — arguably the most-adopted self-directed weight-loss protocol in the market. Users who fast (16:8, or traditional/religious fasts) leave NYUS for a separate timer app, so the behavior driving their result lives outside the app and produces zero coaching signal.

EVIDENCE: Grepped src — no fasting/eating-window/IF surface exists anywhere (only 'fasting blood glucose' as a lab value in the separate vitals idea i-20260708-vitl, unrelated). Intermittent fasting is culturally huge in India (religious fasting traditions + mainstream 16:8/OMAD) and a top weight-loss search intent; dedicated apps (Zero) and every major tracker (HealthifyMe, MyFitnessPal Premium) ship a fasting timer. NYUS already has the pieces to reuse: the notification scheduler + 5 channels + frequency caps (for 'fast complete' / 'eating window open' reminders), the Dashboard gradient-card rhythm (a drop-in card slot), and a daily-log data model. A live countdown ring is also a strong reason-to-open-the-app retention hook that fits the calm-design bar (one ring, no arcade).

V1 SCOPE: One Fasting card on /dashboard plus a lightweight detail view. Preset windows 16:8 / 18:6 / 20:4 / OMAD + custom hours. Start Fast / End Fast drives a live elapsed-time ring vs the target, persisted so it survives app restarts. A simple 7-day history (bars of completed fast hours). ONE notification when the target is reached (reuse the existing scheduler, respect frequency caps). Manual start/stop only — no auto-detection, no meal-timing inference. Framing: neutral tracking with a short safety note (not for anyone with an eating-disorder history; consult a doctor).

EFFORT: ~2-3 days. FE: new dashboard card + detail view + a reused ring + persisted timer state. BE wrinkle: a small fasting_sessions table (start_ts / end_ts / target_hours) + POST/GET + one scheduler reminder job — the only real backend addition.

fix.description: Root cause: Dashboard.tsx passed useDashboardData's computed progress (0 when target===0) to useDashboardMoment, so non-training weekdays and plan-less users read as progress 0 and satisfied the *_BEHIND branches, firing the 'your plan is waiting' nag that contradicts the same-screen 'no workout today'/'Generate plan' card. Proof: regression test test/hooks-useDashboardMoment.test.ts locks the contract both ways (0->BEHIND, -1->generic). The exact rest-day state is not stageable on a single headless capture; the shot shows the healthy dashboard where 'No diet plan yet' now keeps the diet half silent.

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Dashboard coach-moment deck nags “Your workout is still doable today — your plan is waiting, tap Activity to begin” on rest / non-training days AND for users with no workout plan, directly contradicting the same-screen activity card that says “no workout today” (or shows the “Generate workout plan” CTA). EXPECTED: on a day with no scheduled workout (or no plan), the coach tip is neutral/rest-oriented, never “you are behind, your plan is waiting.” ACTUAL: the ACTIVITY_BEHIND pool fires. ROOT CAUSE: useDashboardMoment (src/hooks/useMoments.ts:137-143) branches on `activityProgress >= 0 && activityProgress < 20` (ACTIVITY_BEHIND) and `dietProgress >= 0 && dietProgress < 40` (DIET_BEHIND). The `-1` sentinel defaults (lines 119-120) are meant to signal “no plan / unknown → skip these branches,” but Dashboard.tsx (line 196-208) passes the COMPUTED progress from useDashboardData.progressData, which returns a real `0` whenever target is 0 (useDashboardData.ts:151-153: `activityTarget <= 0 ? 0`). target is 0 on any non-training weekday (has_active_plan=true, no session today, is_break_today=false — the exact state DashboardActivityCard.tsx:96 renders “no workout today” for) and for users with no workout plan. So activityProgress===0 satisfies `>=0 && <20` and ACTIVITY_BEHIND is chosen. Verified with a node repro of the branch: passing 0 → ACTIVITY_BEHIND; passing the intended -1 → COACH_GENERIC (correct). REPRO: (1) log in as a user with an active workout plan; open /dashboard on a non-training weekday — activity card shows “no workout today”. (2) scroll to the coach-moment deck (Section 3). (3) tip reads “Your workout is still doable today. … Your plan is waiting — tap Activity to begin.” Same class hits diet (DIET_BEHIND “Protein is still catchable…”) for a user with no diet plan (dietTarget 0 → dietProgress 0). FIX: in Dashboard.tsx pass -1 (or a hasPlan flag) instead of the computed 0 when target===0, or gate the *_BEHIND branches on target>0 (plan exists + session scheduled today) so the sentinel actually distinguishes “behind” from “nothing scheduled.”

issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Live workout player declares a set the "final set" based purely on set NUMBER, not on whether all target sets were actually logged. In ExerciseWheelPicker.handleLogSet (src/components/ExerciseWheelPicker.tsx:341) it fires onSetComplete(true) whenever setData.set_number === targetSets, with no check that sets 1..targetSets-1 were logged. Activity.handleSetComplete (src/pages/Activity.tsx:672) then advances to the next exercise or declares the whole workout done. Two demonstrable symptoms from the same root cause:

(A) OUT-OF-ORDER LOG -> premature completion. Repro: open an exercise whose target is 3 sets (e.g. 3x8-10), tap the Set 3 row to activate it, and log it FIRST (reverse-pyramid / top-set-first is common for the strength persona this app targets). Expected: nothing special; sets 1-2 still pending. Actual: onSetComplete(true) fires -> if more exercises remain, the "Set complete - Next up" banner pops prompting the user to move on; if this is the last exercise, "Workout complete" + confetti + completion sound fire with only 1 of 3 sets logged.

(B) EDIT-AFTER-COMPLETE -> celebration replays. Repro: log all 3 sets of the LAST exercise normally (workout-complete banner shows, confetti + sound fire once - correct). The picker stays mounted/open above the banner. Tap the already-logged Set 3 row -> the editor expands -> tap "Update". Expected: a silent value update. Actual: handleLogSet runs again with set_number === targetSets -> onSetComplete(true) -> Activity.handleSetComplete else-branch unconditionally re-runs setShowWorkoutCelebration(true) + playCompleteCue(), so the confetti overlay and completion sound REPLAY on every edit of the final set.

Fix: gate completion on distinct logged target sets covering 1..target_sets (count reached), not on set_number equality; and skip re-firing the celebration when showWorkoutComplete is already true.

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Subscription screen shows a FALSE 'Purchases restored' success even when there is nothing to restore. FILE: src/pages/SubscriptionSettings.tsx handleRestore (~lines 177-197). The 'Restore previous purchase' button POSTs /payments/restore-purchases and UNCONDITIONALLY shows the success toast 'Purchases restored / Your subscription has been refreshed' in the try block - it never inspects the response. But the backend (RestoreSubscriptionResource, BACKEND backend.py:2955-2959) returns HTTP 200 with {restored:false, reason:'no active subscription found'} when there is no valid subscription. Because it is a 200 (not 4xx), axios does NOT throw, so the code never reaches the 'Nothing to restore' catch branch - that branch only fires on real network/5xx errors. EXPECTED: a user with no prior purchase taps Restore -> 'Nothing to restore / We couldn't find a previous purchase on this account'. ACTUAL: they get 'Purchases restored / Your subscription has been refreshed' (false success), then load() re-fetches and the card still shows status 'none' - the toast contradicts the screen. REPRO: log in as a free/never-paid account -> /settings/subscription -> tap 'Restore previous purchase' -> false success toast. FIX: read response.data.restored from the POST and branch on it (success toast only when restored===true; otherwise the no-purchases message), mirroring ChoosePlan.handleRestorePurchases which already gates its success toast on the response payload. Keep the catch branch for genuine network/5xx errors.

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Coach chat history is hard-capped at the newest 30 messages - older conversation is permanently unreachable in the UI. CoachChat.tsx:91 fetches chatService.getHistory({ limit: 30 }) once; nothing in the app ever passes before_id (ChatHistoryRequest.before_id has zero UI callers) and the message list has no top-reached loader (no loadMore/fetchNext/hasMore anywhere under coach-chat components or CoachChatMessageList). Scrolling to the top just dead-ends at the 30th-newest message. Since the AI answers every user message and also sends proactive messages, an active user exceeds 30 rows within a day or two - yesterday's plan discussion and coach advice silently vanish. Expected: reaching the top loads older messages (standard chat pattern) - the backend already supports it twice over: /coach/history has page+limit pagination and returns total (app/routes/coach.py:481-490), and legacy /chat/history supports before_id (backend.py:3882-3883). Gotcha for the fix: the FE service plumbs before_id (chat.service.ts:50-52) but the PRIMARY /coach/history endpoint ignores that param entirely (it is page-based) - wiring before_id through without touching the backend would silently re-fetch page 1; use page= against /coach/history or add before_id support server-side. Files: src/pages/CoachChat.tsx:89-97, src/services/chat.service.ts:47-58, src/components/coach/CoachChatMessageList.tsx.

fix.description: Root cause: initI18n() called with explicit lng:'en', bypassing LanguageDetector and overwriting nyus_locale on every boot. Fix (8e2e5a0a): config.ts initI18n() spreads lng only when arg is provided; main.tsx calls initI18n() with no argument, letting detector read nyus_locale from localStorage. Screenshot shows full Profile page in Hindi - language persists across reload.

judge.note: Fix precisely matches auto-diagnosed root cause. Screenshot confirms app running in Hindi with language persisted. Code is correct per i18next semantics.

issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.description: [bug-hunt] Language choice from the startup picker is DESTROYED on every app restart - app always reverts to English. Root cause: main.tsx calls initI18n() with no arg, and config.ts defaults lng=DEFAULT_LOCALE(en), passing an explicit lng:'en' to i18next.init(). Per i18next semantics, an explicit lng bypasses LanguageDetector entirely (stored nyus_locale is never read), AND because detection.caches=['localStorage'], the boot-time changeLanguage('en') REWRITES nyus_locale back to 'en', permanently erasing the user's Hindi/Hinglish choice. Reproduced empirically with the repo's i18next 23.16.8: localStorage nyus_locale='hi' + init with lng:'en' -> language=en and nyus_locale overwritten to 'en'; same init WITHOUT lng -> language=hi, storage intact. Expected: pick Hindi once, app stays Hindi forever. Actual: Hindi only until next launch; picker never re-shows (nyus_lang_picker_shown), so user is stuck in English. Fix: drop the lng option from init (let detector resolve), or pass getStoredLocale() ?? undefined. Files: src/main.tsx:21, src/i18n/config.ts:66-76 (lng param + supportedLngs), src/pages/LanguagePicker.tsx:11-14. Introduced 5f79d6b2 (i18n P1).

Screenshot shows Coach language = Hindi (selected) after startup picker chose Hindi - no manual Profile toggle needed.

issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.description: [bug-hunt] Startup language picker promises the coach speaks your language but never sets coach_language - Hindi/Hinglish pickers still get an ENGLISH AI coach. The picker subtitle literally says 'apni bhasha mein baat karein' (talk in your language), yet setAppLocale() (src/pages/LanguagePicker.tsx:11) only calls i18n.changeLanguage + writes nyus_locale. The backend coach_language pref (drives AI reply language, shipped for i-20260707-lng1) is only settable from Profile > Preferences (ProfilePreferencesCard.tsx handleLangChange -> PUT /profile). Nothing bridges the two: grep shows nyus_locale is read nowhere except the i18n detector, and coach_language is written nowhere except the profile card. Expected: pick Hindi at startup -> UI AND coach replies in Hindi. Actual: coach replies in English until the user separately discovers the buried Profile toggle. Repro: fresh install -> pick Hindi -> onboard -> open coach chat -> replies are English; GET /profile shows coach_language english. Fix: picker is pre-auth, so stash the choice (e.g. from nyus_locale) and apply it to coach_language at login/onboarding finalize (map hi->hindi, hinglish->hinglish, en->english).

Screenshot shows App language row in PREFERENCES & DATA with English/Hinglish/Hindi buttons, Hindi currently selected.

issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.description: [bug-hunt] App language is a one-shot irreversible choice - no UI anywhere to change it after first launch. The startup LanguagePicker renders only while nyus_lang_picker_shown is unset (App.tsx:629); after markPickerShown() it can never be reached again. Grep confirms DISPLAY_LOCALES/setAppLocale are referenced ONLY by the one-shot picker, and Profile > Preferences has just the COACH language toggle (ProfilePreferencesCard.tsx), not app/UI language. The ?lng= querystring override is useless inside the Capacitor native app. Expected: language changeable in Profile settings (config.ts:24 even documents 'Add an entry to the language picker in Profile' as a required step). Actual: tap Skip or pick the wrong language on first launch and you are permanently locked in - only remedy is clear-app-data/reinstall. Repro: first launch -> Skip, use English -> look for any language setting in Profile/preferences -> none exists. Fix: add an App language row to ProfilePreferencesCard using DISPLAY_LOCALES + setAppLocale. Related to (but distinct from) the boot-revert bug filed this tick.
